content.title: Spain vs Serbia: Date, Time And Everything You Need To Know About The 2026 World Cup Friendly
content.text: Home > Soccer > Friendlies > Spain vs Serbia: Date, Time And Everything You Need To Know About The 2026 World Cup FriendlyFriendlies03/26/2026 - 07:35 PM - by Antonio MedinaA qualified powerhouse meets a team seeking redemption. Spain and Serbia face off in a friendly that promises intensity and attacking football.When And Where Is The Match? The match between Spain and Serbia will be played on Friday, March 27, 2026, at Estadio de La Cerámica in Villarreal, Spain.Kick-off is scheduled for 4:00 PM ET / 1:00 PM PT, in what will be an important test for both teams ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.Spain’s Preview Spain arrives in excellent form after securing qualification by finishing top of UEFA Group E.La Roja posted an impressive record: 5 wins, 1 draw, and 0 losses, scoring 21 goals and conceding none, showcasing dominance on both ends of the pitch. Their last official result was a convincing 3-0 win over Serbia in the UEFA Nations League, reinforcing their status as favorites heading into this matchup.Serbia’s Preview Meanwhile, Serbia comes into this game looking to bounce back after failing to qualify for the World Cup. The Balkan side finished third in Group K, behind England and Albania, with 13 points.Their record of 4 wins, 1 draw, and 3 losses was not enough to keep them in contention. Their most recent result—a 3-0 loss to Spain in the Nations League—adds extra motivation for this rematch.Key Players The spotlight for Spain will be on Lamine Yamal, who is enjoying a breakout season with FC Barcelona. The young star has been delivering consistently in both LaLiga and the Champions League, and is expected to lead Spain’s attack not only in this friendly but also on the road to the World Cup.For Serbia, Sergej Milinković-Savić will be the key figure. The Al Hilal midfielder is the brain of the team, capable of dictating tempo, creating chances, and arriving dangerously in the box. His performance will be crucial if Serbia hopes to compete.https://www.instagram.com/p/DWWvqNIDcp_/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==Keys To The Match One of the main factors will be Spain’s control of possession, as they look to dictate the tempo and impose their style from the start. Dominating the midfield will allow them to create consistent scoring opportunities.On the other hand, Serbia will need to rely on intensity and direct play. Capitalizing on transitions and being clinical in front of goal will be essential. Efficiency in both boxes could ultimately decide the outcome.Final Verdict On paper, Spain enters as the clear favorite, thanks to both home advantage and their superior quality and playing style.However, Serbia has the tools to compete and will look to respond after missing out on the World Cup. Expect an entertaining match filled with goals and attacking intent, as both teams prepare for the 2026 World Cup.Friendlies
